name: growthub-gtm
description: Use Growthub’s CEO, saved Characters, brand context and connected tools for real go-to-market work. Retrieve saved results and repeat accepted work through existing Routines.

interface.longDescription: Direct your Growthub CEO and saved Characters, use approved Brand Kit context and connected business tools, and retrieve saved results. Package workflows for research, campaigns, content and repeat work using your existing Growthub setup. Existing plan, provider account, device availability, scopes and approvals apply. Routine scheduling and publication use the existing Growthub controls. API-token-backed CEO and Knowledge access require a provider surface that supports the existing token connection. See the support matrix before installation.
defaultPrompt: Have my Growthub team research a campaign and return a reviewable brief.
Ask my saved Character to do the next growth task and show its saved result.
Help me repeat an accepted Growthub task through my existing Routine controls.
